can you explain what a logical data model is?

A logical data model provides an abstract representation of the concepts within a database, their attributes (characteristics), and relationships between these entities. It helps in understanding how different types of information relate to each other without delving into technical details like physical storage or specific implementation methods that are part of the conceptual and external models respectively.
